---
name: development
description: >
  Develop features and authorized bug fixes with architecture discovery, tests, and verified completion.
---


Read the Task Contract and Feature Map, then identify source, dependencies and data ownership.
Define the evidence plan before coding. Implement small focused changes with unit tests.
Run the existing project build, relevant contract/integration tests, and the verification workflow.
If root cause is unknown, investigate rather than change arbitrary code.
Deliver diff, test commands, evidence report and any BLOCKED external dependencies.
Do not claim a PR is approved, merged or deployed until GitHub actually confirms it.
